sentences.text:
Heard on I.A. No.6894/2025, fourth repeat application filed under Section 389 (1) of Cr.P.C. for
suspension of sentence filed on behalf of appellant No.2-Ajeet.

2. Present appellant is facing sentence by virtue of judgment dated 05/10/2018 passed by the First Additional Sessions Judge, Jaura District Morena in ST No.164/2018; whereby, he has been convicted and sentenced as under:-
 Section Imprisonment Fine  376 (D) of IPC 20 Years' R.I. Rs.20,000/- with de  324 of IPC 01 Year's R.I. Rs.1,000/- with def 3.

entities.text: First Additional Sessions Judge, Jaura District Morena
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is the submission of counsel for appellant that trial Court erred in convicting present appellant and awarding jail sentence.
It is further submitted that present appellant has already suffered 6 years and 10 months of incarceration as pre and post trial confinement.
Prosecutrix did not support the story of prosecution and declared hostile by the prosecution.
No deposition exits against appellant in respect of commission of the offence.
Final hearing of the appeal shall take substantial time and he has a good case on merits.
Present appellant undertakes not to be a source of embarrassment and harassment to the complainant/victim side in any manner.
He furthher 2 CRA-8472-2018 undertakes to abide by the terms and conditions as imposed by this Court.
Under these circumstances, he prayed for grant of suspension of sentence and grant of bail.
4 . Per contra, learned Counsel for the State opposed the application and prays for its rejection while supporting the impugned judgment.
5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and record perused.

sentences.text: Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, this Court intends to allow the application for suspension of sentence (I.A. No.6894/2025).

If appellant No.2-Ajeet furnishes bail bond in the sum o f Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) along with two solvent sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court that he shall appear before the Principal Registrar of this Court on 14/07/2025 and on all other subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Office for appearance, then he shall be released on bail and execution of his jail sentence is suspended till disposal of this appeal, subject to deposit of fine amount.

7. As per the mandate of Apex Court in the case of Aparna Bhatt Vs. State of M.P. reported in 2021 SCC Online 230, it is further directed that present appellant shall not move in the vicinity of the complainant/victim side and shall not be source of embarrassment and harassment to the prosecutrix and her family members in any manner and will not try to contact them in person/through somebody else or through electronic media; otherwise, his benefit of suspension of sentence shall immediately be withdrawn.

entities.text: Aparna Bhatt Vs. State of M.P. reported in 2021 SCC Online 230
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
8 . That apart, present appellant shall mark his presence first on 3 CRA-8472-2018 20/05/2025 at Police Station Devgarh, District Morena and thereafter, on first Sunday of every alternate month (next would be 1st week of July, 2025 and so on) for a period of next two years i.e. till May, 2027;
otherwise, his benefit of suspension of sentence shall immediately be withdrawn.

9. It is the duty of SHO of Police Station Devgarh, District Morena to inform prosecutrix/victim about this order and if appellant is source of embarrassment and harassment to the complainant side and prosecutrix in any manner, then they shall move an application for cancellation of bail immediately and in case of any adversity, SHO of concerned police station shall take appropriate steps for protection of prosecutrix.
10. The I.A. stands allowed and disposed of.
11. Copy of this order be sent to the concerned Trial Court as well as the Police Station for information and necessary compliance.
12. Certified copy as per rules.

(ANAND PATHAK) 
 JUDGE   (Dubey)
